# Preserved proposal 1.0.0

The files in `1.0.0/` are exact copies of the pre-decision manifest, metrics,
catalog, guide and Phase 1 report. Their pending-review statements and relative
links describe the historical layout; they are not the current baseline status.

The complete original tree, tooling and original link destinations are preserved
at [commit 8afdacd](https://github.com/ankit8github/FootPrint/tree/8afdacdb9b3a3011eb4944c743bd5a1e3e923cc5).
Original REVIEW.md, HUMAN-REVIEW-WORKSHEET.md and the taxonomy proposal remain
unchanged at their original paths, with no reviewer judgments filled in.

Current baseline: [manifest 1.1.0](../manifest.json),
[approved decision](../../../../../docs/PHASE1-TAXONOMY-DECISION.md).
The 27 raw files are shared unchanged; their hashes are identical across versions.
Use the historical tooling at that commit to reproduce validation of 1.0.0.
